caseName: Bank of America, N.A. v. Garro
caseNameFull: BANK OF AMERICA, N.A. v. Rosa Liliana GARRO

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit. Petition for writ of eer-*1070tiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit for further consideration in light of Bank of America, N.A. v. Caulkett, 575 U.S. -, 135 S.Ct. 1995, 192 L.E.2d 52 (2015).
